blockers.resolution_required: Obtain maintainer-certified AM/AP/BC/BD/BS/BT efficiencies and pointings with hashes and a documented resolution of the 2019 withdrawal, or independently reconstruct and validate them under a separately locked parity protocol.
Lock the eight sky regions, ten characterization components, eleven published footprint rows, filter/color treatment, and detection-level versus physical-object alias rules.
Choose and hash one DES release and lock handling of three nc objects, the Centaur, the Oort-cloud comet, H_r revisions, state epoch/time scale, covariance, and count likelihood.
Reconcile exposure counts, griz-only behavior, transient efficiency, distance-dependent triplet windows, bandpasses, ephemeris backend, dependencies, RNG, and qualification tests.
Acquire or formally account for the unavailable DES transient, fake-injection, linkage, candidate, and inclusion artifacts and the full OSSOS selection provenance.

Acquire a content-addressed common checkpoint and paired M0/M1 decks with identical particles, known-body history, tides/stars, epoch/frame, integrator, cadence, loss rules, nuisance model, code, seeds, and outputs; only the registered compact body may differ.
Recover the original metadata blob and who/when/rule/universe/ranking decision record, and define a physically valid propagation from the catalog epoch rather than redeclaring the elements.

Label all reused observations as previously inspected and either lock an explicit exploratory or held-out-prediction claim or identify a genuinely untouched survey/chronological holdout with custodian evidence.
Obtain authoritative data and software license statements where missing and predeclare a DOI-backed, content-addressed archive destination.

next_gate.minimum_exit_condition: Every G0 blocker must be resolved in hash-bound public artifacts and independently audited before drafting G1.

mandatory_nonclaim: This audit contains no JX-O2 observational statistic or model preference and authorizes no execution. It does not detect, confirm, exclude, or rule out Planet X.
